description: This file defines the ReplyTarget interface, which models a target for handling outbound Ditto command responses, including methods for JSON serialization/deserialization, builder pattern support, and accessors for address, header mapping, and expected response types.

classes.name: ReplyTarget
classes.description: An interface representing a reply target used to handle outbound command responses in the Ditto framework, providing methods for JSON conversion, builder creation, and accessors for target properties.

classes.name: ReplyTarget.Builder
classes.description: A builder interface for constructing instances of ReplyTarget, allowing configuration of address, header mapping, and expected response types.

classes.name: ReplyTarget.JsonFields
classes.description: A final class containing JSON field definitions for the ReplyTarget object, including address, header mapping, and expected response types.

methods.name: fromJson
methods.description: Creates a ReplyTarget instance from a JSON object.

methods.name: newBuilder
methods.description: Creates a new builder for constructing a ReplyTarget instance.

methods.name: toBuilder
methods.description: Creates a builder initialized with the current state of this ReplyTarget.

methods.name: toJson
methods.description: Serializes this ReplyTarget to a JSON object, optionally using a specified schema version and field selector.
